apps.name: SpotiFLAC Mobile
apps.subtitle: FLAC Downloader for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: SpotiFLAC Mobile is an open-source Spotify track and playlist metadata downloader and FLAC converter for iOS and Android. Search and download high-quality FLAC and MP3 audio with complete ID3 metadata, embedded album artwork, and synchronized lyrics directly on your device.
apps.versionDescription:
SpotiFLAC 5.0.0 | SpotiFLAC-v5.0.0-ios-unsigned

### New Features

- **onboarding**: Add theme-aware 5.0 upgrade introduction
- **library**: Add Mornye browsing and contextual compact navigation
- **home**: Add large featured cards for extension feeds
- **mornye**: Separate Search into a circular navigation button
- **profile**: Add local profiles with backup and restore
- **player**: Add beat-matched AutoMix and refine Mornye navigation
- **artists**: Add branded headers and incremental release loading
- **mornye**: Cache motion covers and refine player and search
- **ui**: Add Mornye glass theme and adaptive music player
- Add opt-in Discord Rich Presence on Android
- **metadata**: Display saved ReplayGain values and refresh after analysis
- **backend**: Migrate production backend to Rust
- **backup**: Allow selecting categories and settings-only backups

### Bug Fixes

- **ci**: Audit stripped iOS archives and configure FFmpeg tests
- Retry verification browser launch and failed searches
- Sync lyric romanization and clear stale selection menus
- **mornye**: Show track summary and update welcome branding
- **metadata**: Remove nested barcode card background
- **mornye**: Preserve icon meaning and use consistent settings accents
- **settings**: Simplify player copy and add glass library info card
- **ui**: Resolve album titles and show Home explicit badges
- **ui**: Align local lyrics and refine Mornye selection
- **player**: Preserve offline motion artwork and smooth cover changes
- **ios**: Keep release feed bundle identity in sync
- **android**: Validate native metadata editor results
- Preserve source artist credits when downloading
- **library**: Reset checkpoints and artwork on forced full scans
- **metadata**: Read tags and covers from MP4 files named opus
- **library**: Preserve cached covers across directory aliases
- **download**: Log provider failures before fallback
- **extensions**: Restore URL globals for provider link resolution
- **download**: Preserve filenames after automatic SAF conversion
- **backup**: Allow selecting SFLB archives for restore

### Performance

- **rust**: Stream discarded FLAC artwork during replacement
- **extensions**: Avoid copying unwrapped Base64 input
- **bridge**: Reduce metadata copies and decode large JSON off the UI isolate
- **analysis**: Reuse sorted spectral percentile windows
- **audio**: Share the Opus artwork metadata buffer
- **search**: Release derived caches when track results change
- **library**: Dispose unused playback row subscriptions
- **metadata**: Move normalized Rust values into response envelopes
- **rust**: Reduce peak allocations when resizing cover artwork
- **mornye**: Reuse exact luminance contributions for contrast sampling
- **mornye**: Release outgoing artwork decoders when replaced
- **player**: Scope position and contrast rebuilds to controls
- **extensions**: Collect unreachable JavaScript cycles after idle bursts
- **images**: Decode local covers to their fitted display size
- **extensions**: Share retained source text across manager and VMs
- **extensions**: Reuse owned UTF-8 buffers at text boundaries
- **metadata**: Preserve typed values across the Rust extension bridge
- **extensions**: Validate JSON without allocating argument trees
- **cue**: Parse SAF previews without copying audio
- **android**: Batch SAF library recovery metadata queries
- **library**: Batch album deletion and refresh once
- **android**: Batch SAF lookups during download publication
- **downloads**: Log finalization stage durations
- **audio**: Validate FLAC remuxes before encoder fallback
- **downloads**: Reuse lyrics supplied by the backend
- **downloads**: Reuse HTTP connections between tracks
- **lyrics**: Stream MP3 audio when updating ID3 lyrics
- **analysis**: Serialize and cancel owned FFmpeg sessions
- **backup**: Move archive processing off the UI isolate
- **player**: Commit seek gestures once after scrubbing
- **ui**: Pause motion headers when collapsed
- **theme**: Bound cover palette decoding and coalesce requests
- **rust**: Skip audio rewrites for identical FLAC metadata

### Refactoring

- **ui**: Unify theme styling and enlarge profile button

### Styling

- Remove trailing whitespace

### Dependencies

- **deps**: Update Flutter and iOS plugin dependencies

### Chores

- **rust**: Update crypto, network and UniFFI dependencies
- **android**: Update native dependencies and build tooling
- **analyzer**: Exclude archived internal sources
- **release**: Set app version to 5.0.0+152
- Update AltStore source to v4.9.6 by [@github-actions[bot]](https://github.com/github-actions[bot])




**Full Changelog**: [v4.9.6...v5.0.0](https://github.com/spotiflacapp/SpotiFLAC-Mobile/compare/v4.9.6...v5.0.0)

---

### Downloads

#### Android
- **arm64**: `SpotiFLAC-v5.0.0-arm64.apk` (recommended for modern devices)
- **arm32**: `SpotiFLAC-v5.0.0-arm32.apk` (older devices)

#### iOS
- **iOS**: `SpotiFLAC-v5.0.0-ios-unsigned.ipa` (sideload required)

### Installation
**Android**: Enable "Install from unknown sources" and install the APK
**iOS**: Use AltStore, Sideloadly, or similar tools to sideload the IPA
